title: Domain Models & DTO Mapping
objectives: Distinguish entities, value objects and DTOs
Use newtypes and discriminated unions to make illegal states unrepresentable

examples.name: newtypes.ts

exercise.prompt: Classify each type: "UserId(u64)" (entity id), "Money { cents, currency }" (value object), "UserJson { name, email }" (DTO), "OrderStatus enum" (state machine).
hints: Value objects are defined by value and immutable.
DTOs are wire shapes; enums model state machines.

questions.prompt: Why map DTOs to domain types at the boundary?
options: so serialization concerns stay out of business rules
questions.explanation: The boundary is the single place where untrusted shapes get validated and converted.

options: accidentally mixing raw integers with monetary values
questions.explanation: Distinct types make mixing units a compile error instead of a production bug.
